previous_statement: Because 1.2 makes <.,.>_n positive definite on the amplified P,Q column space, its Hilbert norm is q_P and the elementary Riesz duality formula applies: q_P(D)=sup_{Y != 0}|<Y,D>_n|/q_P(Y).
